ja226:1.1: Going at the right time is good,
ja226:1.2: not going at the wrong time is good,
ja226:1.3: By going out at the wrong time,
ja226:1.4: alone, and with the many folk,
ja226:1.5: Nothing explains the meaning like the owl with the army of crows.
ja226:2.1: The wise one knows the rules and commands,
ja226:2.4: he will be happy like the owl.
